added: There's nothing like a batch of homemade cookies to lift your spirits and make your house smell wonderful. Homemade cookies aren't much more difficult to make than the slice and bake kind, but they taste a lot better. Read on to learn how to make a variety of popular cookies.
[[Category:Cookies and Biscuits]]
==Ingredients==
===Chocolate Chip Cookies===
*½ cup unsalted butter, room temperature
*¾ cup brown sugar
*¾ cup white sugar
*2 eggs
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*12 ounces chocolate chips
*2 ¼ cups plain flour
*½ teaspoon salt
*½ teaspoon baking soda
===Sugar Cookies===
*1 cup butter, room temperature
*1 cup white sugar
*1 egg
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*2 ¾ cups plain flour
*2 teaspoons baking powder
===No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies===
*1 ¾ cups white sugar
*½ cup milk
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*½ cup peanut butter
*3 cups quick oatmeal
*½ teaspoon salt
===Ginger Cookies===
*¾ cup butter, room temperature
*½ cup brown sugar
*½ cup white sugar
*¼ cup molasses
*1 egg
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*2 cups plain flour
*½ teaspoon baking soda
*½ teaspoon salt
*1 ½ teaspoons ground cinnamon
*1 ½ teaspoons ground ginger
*½ teaspoon ground cloves
== Steps ==
===Making Chocolate Chip Cookies===
#[[Preheat an Oven|Preheat the oven]] to 350°F (180°C).[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 1 Version 2.jpg|center]]
#Mix and sift the dry ingredients. Put the flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl and whisk them together.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 2 Version 2.jpg|center]]

#Cream the butter and sugars in a separate bowl. Place them in a large bowl and use a hand mixer to beat them together until the butter and sugars are fully combined and the mixture has turned light and fluffy.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 3 Version 2.jpg|center]]
#Add the eggs and vanilla. Keep beating the mixture until the eggs and vanilla are completely blended in.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 4 Version 2.jpg|center]]

#Stir in the flour mixture. Use a long-handled spoon to stir the dry ingredients in with the wet; keep stirring until you can't see any white specks of flour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 5 Version 2.jpg|center]]
#Mix in the chocolate chips. Pour them into the bowl and use the spoon to mix them in with the batter.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 6 Version 2.jpg|center]]

#Drop spoonfuls of batter onto a baking sheet. Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to scoop even amounts of batter onto a baking sheet. Space them an inch or two apart so they'll have room to spread while baking.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 7 Version 2.jpg|center]]
#*To keep the cookies from sticking to the baking sheet, you can line it with parchment paper before placing the cookies on it.
#*For perfectly even cookies, use a 1/8 measuring cup to scoop the batter.

#Bake the cookies. Place the cookie sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes, or until they turn golden brown on top and the edges look slightly crisp.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 8 Version 2.jpg|center]]

#Remove the cookies from the oven to cool. Place them on a cooling rack or move them to a plate and let them cool until they aren't too hot to eat.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 9 Version 2.jpg|center]]
# Finished. Enjoy! [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 10 Version 2.jpg|center]]
===Making Sugar Cookies===
# Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).<ref>[v162092_b01]. 11 March 2022.</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 11 Version 2.jpg|center]]
#Mix the dry ingredients. Place the flour and baking soda in a bowl. Whisk until they are fully combined.<ref>[v162092_b01]. 11 March 2022.</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 12.jpg|center]]

#Cream the wet ingredients in a separate bowl.<ref>[v162092_b01]. 11 March 2022.</ref> Place the butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla in a bowl and beat until the ingredients are incorporated and the mixture is light and fluffy.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 13.jpg|center]]

#Mix the wet and dry ingredients. Pour the flour mixture into the bowl of wet ingredients.<ref>[v162092_b01]. 11 March 2022.</ref> Use a long-handled spoon to stir the batter until you can no longer see the specks of white flour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 14.jpg|center]]

#Drop the cookies onto a baking sheet. Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to place even amounts of cookie dough onto the baking sheet. Space them an inch or two apart to allow the cookies room to spread.<ref>http://www.food.com/recipe/eloises-easy-sugar-cookies-82945</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 15.jpg|center]]
#Flatten the cookies. Use the bottom of a drinking glass to press the cookies flat.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 16.jpg|center]]
#Sprinkle the cookies with sugar. This will give the cookies a sweet, crunchy finish.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 17.jpg|center]]
#Bake the cookies. Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes, or until the tops turn slightly golden.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 18.jpg|center]]
#Let the cookies cool. Remove them from the oven and place them on a cooling rack or a plate. Let them cool for a minute or two before eating.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 19.jpg|center]]
#Decorate the cookies. Sugar cookies are fun to decorate with glaze or icing. Add sprinkles or edible glitter to make them look festive. [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 20.jpg|center]]
===Making No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies===

#Boil the milk and sugar. Place them in a saucepan. Put the saucepan on the stove and turn the burner to medium high. Let the milk and sugar come to a boil and cook, stirring constantly, until the sugar dissolves, which should take about 5 minutes. Remove the mixture from heat.<ref>http://www.shugarysweets.com/2013/04/peanut-butter-no-bake-cookies</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 21.jpg|center]]
#Add the vanilla, peanut butter and salt. Pour the ingredients into the saucepan and stir them in until they're completely incorporated.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 22.jpg|center]]
#*You can add 1/2 cup of cocoa powder to make chocolate peanut butter cookies.
#*Stir in 1/2 cup peanut butter
#Stir in the oatmeal.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 23.jpg|center]]

#Scoop the cookies onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to scoop the batter in even amounts onto a baking sheet.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 24.jpg|center]]

#Let the cookies cool for 15 minutes. As they cool, they'll harden slightly. When you can pick them up without them falling apart, they're ready to eat.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 25.jpg|center]]

#Store leftover cookies in the refrigerator. Save some treats for later by storing them in the fridge, which will keep them from melting and falling apart. [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 26.jpg|center]]
===Making Ginger Cookies===

#Mix the dry ingredients. Put the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ground ginger, and ground cloves in a bowl. Use a whisk to stir the ingredients together.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 27.jpg|center]]

#Cream the butter and sugars in a separate bowl. Place them in a mixing bowl and use a hand mixer to beat the ingredients until they become light and fluffy.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 28.jpg|center]]

#Add the remaining wet ingredients. Place the egg, vanilla, and molasses in the bowl with the butter and sugars. Beat the wet ingredients until they are fully combined.<ref>http://www.joyofbaking.com/Gingersnaps.html</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 29.jpg|center]]

#Mix the wet and dry ingredients. Pour the flour mixture into the bowl with the wet ingredients. Use a spoon to stir the batter until you no longer see specks of white flour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 30.jpg|center]]

#Form the batter into a ball and chill it. Use your hands to form it into a ball shape, then place it on a sheet of plastic wrap and pull up the edges to completely wrap the dough ball. Put it in the refrigerator and chill for 1/2 hour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 31.jpg|center]]
#Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 32.jpg|center]]

#Roll out the dough. Remove the dough from the refrigerator, unwrap it, and put it on a floured work surface. Use a floured rolling pin to roll the dough to {{convert|1/4|in|cm|adj=on|1|1}} thickness.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 33.jpg|center]]
#Cut the dough. Use a cookie cutter to cut the dough, then place the unbaked cookies on a baking sheet as you go.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 34.jpg|center]]
#Bake the cookies. Place the cookie sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes. Remove them from the oven before the edges brown.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 35.jpg|center]]
#Let the cookies cool. Place them on a cooling rack or a plate and let them cool for a minute before eating. [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 36.jpg|center]]
=== Making Other Cookies ===
#[[Make Almond Biscotti Cookies | Make homemade biscotti]]. This Italian cookie is usually served with espresso or red wine.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 37.jpg|center]]
#[[Make Snickerdoodles | Make snickerdoodles]]. This riff on the sugar cookie combines the delectable flavors of cinnamon and sugar.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 38.jpg|center]]
#[[Bake Oatmeal Cookies | Make oatmeal cookies]]. These hearty cookies make a great after school snack.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 39.jpg|center]]

#[[Make Double Chocolate and Chocolate Chip Cookies | Make double chocolate cookies]]. There's nothing like two types of chocolate in the same cookie to satisfy your cravings.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 40.jpg|center]]
#[[Make Thumbprint Cookies | Make thumbprint cookies]]. They're a combination of buttery shortbread and sweet jam.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 41.jpg|center]]
#[[Make Lemon Drop Cookies | Make lemon drop cookies]]. These little bursts of sunshine are a perfect treat for afternoon tea.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 42.jpg|center]]
== Video ==
{{Video:Make Homemade Cookies|}}
== Tips ==
* If you don't have the baking soda, use self-raising flour instead.
* Make sure to set a timer; otherwise you may end up with burnt cookies!
* You don't have to use chocolate chips; any chocolate will work, so long as it is in smallish pieces.
* These cookies work great with a sugar substitute.
* If you have access to caster sugar, you can use that in place of white sugar for a finer texture.

*¾ cup brown sugar

*2 ¼ cups plain flour
*½ teaspoon salt
*½ teaspoon baking soda
===Sugar Cookies===
*1 cup butter, room temperature
*1 cup white sugar
*1 egg

*2 ¾ cups plain flour
*2 teaspoons baking powder

*½ cup milk

*½ cup peanut butter
*3 cups quick oatmeal
*½ teaspoon salt

*½ cup brown sugar
*½ cup white sugar
*¼ cup molasses
*1 egg

*2 cups plain flour
*½ teaspoon baking soda
*½ teaspoon salt
*1 ½ teaspoons ground cinnamon
*1 ½ teaspoons ground ginger
*½ teaspoon ground cloves

#Stir in the flour mixture. Use a long-handled spoon to stir the dry ingredients in with the wet; keep stirring until you can't see any white specks of flour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 5 Version 2.jpg|center]]
#Mix in the chocolate chips. Pour them into the bowl and use the spoon to mix them in with the batter.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 6 Version 2.jpg|center]]

#Drop spoonfuls of batter onto a baking sheet. Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to scoop even amounts of batter onto a baking sheet. #*To keep the cookies from sticking to the baking sheet, you can line it with parchment paper before placing the cookies on it.

== Tips ==
* If you don't have the baking soda, use self-raising flour instead.
* You don't have to use chocolate chips; any chocolate will work, so long as it is in smallish pieces.
* Make sure to set a timer; otherwise you may end up with burnt cookies!
* These cookies work great with a sugar substitute.
* If you have access to caster sugar, you can use that in place of white sugar for a finer texture.

#Bake the cookies. Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes, or until the tops turn slightly golden.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 18.jpg|center]]
#Let the cookies cool. Remove them from the oven and place them on a cooling rack or a plate. Let them cool for a minute or two before eating.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 19.jpg|center]]

===Making No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies===

#Boil the milk and sugar. Place them in a saucepan. Put the saucepan on the stove and turn the burner to medium high. Let the milk and sugar come to a boil and cook, stirring constantly, until the sugar dissolves, which should take about 5 minutes. Remove the mixture from heat.<ref>http://www.shugarysweets.com/2013/04/peanut-butter-no-bake-cookies</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 21.jpg|center]]
#Add the vanilla, peanut butter and salt. Pour the ingredients into the saucepan and stir them in until they're completely incorporated.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 22.jpg|center]]
#*You can add 1/2 cup of cocoa powder to make chocolate peanut butter cookies.
#*Stir in 1/2 cup peanut butter
#Stir in the oatmeal.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 23.jpg|center]]

#Scoop the cookies onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to scoop the batter in even amounts onto a baking sheet.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 24.jpg|center]]

#Let the cookies cool for 15 minutes. As they cool, they'll harden slightly. When you can pick them up without them falling apart, they're ready to eat.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 25.jpg|center]]

#Store leftover cookies in the refrigerator. Save some treats for later by storing them in the fridge, which will keep them from melting and falling apart. [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 26.jpg|center]]
===Making Ginger Cookies===

#Mix the dry ingredients. Put the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ground ginger, and ground cloves in a bowl. Use a whisk to stir the ingredients together.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 27.jpg|center]]

#Cream the butter and sugars in a separate bowl. Place them in a mixing bowl and use a hand mixer to beat the ingredients until they become light and fluffy.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 28.jpg|center]]

#Add the remaining wet ingredients. Place the egg, vanilla, and molasses in the bowl with the butter and sugars. Beat the wet ingredients until they are fully combined.<ref>http://www.joyofbaking.com/Gingersnaps.html</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 29.jpg|center]]

#Mix the wet and dry ingredients. Pour the flour mixture into the bowl with the wet ingredients. Use a spoon to stir the batter until you no longer see specks of white flour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 30.jpg|center]]

#Form the batter into a ball and chill it. Use your hands to form it into a ball shape, then place it on a sheet of plastic wrap and pull up the edges to completely wrap the dough ball. Put it in the refrigerator and chill for 1/2 hour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 31.jpg|center]]
#Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 32.jpg|center]]

#Roll out the dough. Remove the dough from the refrigerator, unwrap it, and put it on a floured work surface. Use a floured rolling pin to roll the dough to {{convert|1/4|in|cm|adj=on|1|1}} thickness.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 33.jpg|center]]
#Cut the dough. Use a cookie cutter to cut the dough, then place the unbaked cookies on a baking sheet as you go.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 34.jpg|center]]
#Bake the cookies. Place the cookie sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes. Remove them from the oven before the edges brown.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 35.jpg|center]]
#Let the cookies cool. Place them on a cooling rack or a plate and let them cool for a minute before eating. [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 36.jpg|center]]

== Tips ==
* If you don't have the baking soda, use self-raising flour instead.
* You don't have to use chocolate chips; any chocolate will work, so long as it is in smallish pieces.
* Make sure to set a timer; otherwise you may end up with burnt cookies!
* These cookies work great with a sugar substitute.
* If you have access to caster sugar, you can use that in place of white sugar for a finer texture.

added: There's nothing like a batch of homemade cookies to lift your spirits and make your house smell wonderful. Homemade cookies aren't much more difficult to make than the slice and bake kind, but they taste a lot better. Read on to learn how to make a variety of popular cookies.
[[Category:Cookies and Biscuits]]
==Ingredients==
===Chocolate Chip Cookies===
*½ cup unsalted butter, room temperature
*¾ cup brown sugar
*¾ cup white sugar
*2 eggs
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*12 ounces chocolate chips
*2 ¼ cups flour
*½ teaspoon salt
*½ teaspoon baking soda
===Sugar Cookies===
*1 cup butter, room temperature
*1 cup sugar
*1 egg
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*2 ¾ cups flour
*2 teaspoons baking powder
===No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies===
*1 ¾ cups sugar
*½ cup milk
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*½ cup peanut butter
*3 cups quick oatmeal
*½ teaspoon salt
===Ginger Cookies===
*¾ cup butter, room temperature
*½ cup brown sugar
*½ cup white sugar
*¼ cup molasses
*1 egg
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*2 cups flour
*½ teaspoon baking soda
*½ teaspoon salt
*1 ½ teaspoons ground cinnamon
*1 ½ teaspoons ground ginger
*½ teaspoon ground cloves
== Steps ==
===Chocolate Chip Cookies===
#Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 1 Version 2.jpg|center]]
#Mix and sift the dry ingredients. Put the flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl and whisk them together.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 2 Version 2.jpg|center]]

#Cream the butter and sugars in a separate bowl. Place them in a large bowl and use a hand mixer to beat them together until the butter and sugars are fully combined and the mixture has turned light and fluffy.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 3 Version 2.jpg|center]]

#Add the eggs and vanilla. Keep beating the mixture until the eggs and vanilla are completely blended in.[[Image:Make Sugar Cookies Step 03.jpg|thumb|description]][[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 4 Version 2.jpg|center]]

#Stir in the flour mixture. Use a long-handled spoon to stir the dry ingredients in with the wet; keep stirring until you can't see any white specks of flour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 5 Version 2.jpg|center]]
#Mix in the chocolate chips. Pour them into the bowl and use the spoon to mix them in with the batter.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 6 Version 2.jpg|center]]

#Drop spoonfuls of batter onto a baking sheet. Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to scoop even amounts of batter onto a baking sheet. Space them an inch or two apart so they'll have room to spread while baking.<ref>http://www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/food-network-kitchens/chocolate-chip-cookies-recipe4/index.html</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 7 Version 2.jpg|center]]
#*To keep the cookies from sticking to the baking sheet, you can line it with parchment paper before placing the cookies on it.
#*For perfectly even cookies, use a 1/8 measuring cup to scoop the batter.

#Bake the cookies. Place the cookie sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes, or until they turn golden brown on top and the edges look slightly crisp.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 8 Version 2.jpg|center]]

#Remove the cookies from the oven to cool. Place them on a cooling rack or move them to a plate and let them cool until they aren't too hot to eat.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 9 Version 2.jpg|center]]
# Finished. Enjoy! [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 10 Version 2.jpg|center]]
===Sugar Cookies===
# Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 11 Version 2.jpg|center]]
#Mix the dry ingredients. Place the flour, salt and baking soda in a bowl. Whisk until they are fully combined.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 12.jpg|center]]

#Cream the wet ingredients in a separate bowl. Place the butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla in a bowl and beat until the ingredients are incorporated and the mixture is light and fluffy.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 13.jpg|center]]

#Mix the wet and dry ingredients. Pour the flour mixture into the bowl of wet ingredients. Use a long-handled spoon to stir the batter until you can no longer see the specks of white flour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 14.jpg|center]]

#Drop the cookies onto a baking sheet. Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to place even amounts of cookie dough onto the baking sheet. Space them an inch or two apart to allow the cookies room to spread.<ref>http://www.food.com/recipe/eloises-easy-sugar-cookies-82945</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 15.jpg|center]]
#Flatten the cookies. Use the bottom of a drinking glass to press the cookies flat.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 16.jpg|center]]
#Sprinkle the cookies with sugar. This will give the cookies a sweet, crunchy finish.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 17.jpg|center]]
#Bake the cookies. Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes, or until the tops turn slightly golden.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 18.jpg|center]]
#Let the cookies cool. Remove them from the oven and place them on a cooling rack or a plate. Let them cool for a minute or two before eating.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 19.jpg|center]]
#Decorate the cookies. Sugar cookies are fun to decorate with glaze or icing. Add sprinkles or edible glitter to make them look festive. [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 20.jpg|center]]
===No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies===

#Boil the milk and sugar. Place them in a saucepan. Put the saucepan on the stove and turn the burner to medium high. Let the milk and sugar come to a boil and cook, stirring constantly, until the sugar dissolves, which should take about 5 minutes. Remove the mixture from heat.<ref>http://www.shugarysweets.com/2013/04/peanut-butter-no-bake-cookies</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 21.jpg|center]]
#Add the vanilla, peanut butter and salt. Pour the ingredients into the saucepan and stir them in until they're completely incorporated.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 22.jpg|center]]
#*You can add 1/2 cup of cocoa powder to make chocolate peanut butter cookies.
#*Stir in 1/2
#Stir in the oatmeal.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 23.jpg|center]]

#Scoop the cookies onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to scoop the batter in even amounts onto a baking sheet.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 24.jpg|center]]

#Let the cookies cool for 15 minutes. As they cool, they'll harden slightly. When you can pick them up without them falling apart, they're ready to eat.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 25.jpg|center]]

#Store leftover cookies in the refrigerator. Save some treats for later by storing them in the fridge, which will keep them from melting and falling apart. [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 26.jpg|center]]
===Ginger Cookies===

#Mix the dry ingredients. Put the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ground ginger, and ground cloves in a bowl. Use a whisk to stir the ingredients together.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 27.jpg|center]]

#Cream the butter and sugars in a separate bowl. Place them in a mixing bowl and use a hand mixer to beat the ingredients until they become light and fluffy.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 28.jpg|center]]

#Add the remaining wet ingredients. Place the egg, vanilla, and molasses in the bowl with the butter and sugars. Beat the wet ingredients until they are fully combined.<ref>http://www.joyofbaking.com/Gingersnaps.html</ref>[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 29.jpg|center]]

#Mix the wet and dry ingredients. Pour the flour mixture into the bowl with the wet ingredients. Use a spoon to stir the batter until you no longer see specks of white flour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 30.jpg|center]]

#Form the batter into a ball and chill it. Use your hands to form it into a ball shape, then place it on a sheet of plastic wrap and pull up the edges to completely wrap the dough ball. Put it in the refrigerator and chill for 1/2 hour.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 31.jpg|center]]
#Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 32.jpg|center]]

#Roll out the dough. Remove the dough from the refrigerator, unwrap it, and put it on a floured work surface. Use a floured rolling pin to roll the dough to {{convert|1/4|in|cm|adj=on|1|1}} thickness.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 33.jpg|center]]
#Cut the dough. Use a cookie cutter to cut the dough, then place the unbaked cookies on a baking sheet as you go.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 34.jpg|center]]
#Bake the cookies. Place the cookie sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes. Remove them from the oven before the edges brown.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 35.jpg|center]]
#Let the cookies cool. Place them on a cooling rack or a plate and let them cool for a minute before eating. [[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 36.jpg|center]]
=== Other Cookies ===
#[[Make Almond Biscotti Cookies | Make homemade biscotti]]. This Italian cookie is usually served with espresso or red wine.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 37.jpg|center]]
#[[Make Snickerdoodles | Make snickerdoodles]]. This riff on the sugar cookie combines the delectable flavors of cinnamon and sugar.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 38.jpg|center]]
#[[Bake Oatmeal Cookies | Make oatmeal cookies]]. These hearty cookies make a great after school snack.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 39.jpg|center]]

#[[Make Double Chocolate and Chocolate Chip Cookies | Make double chocolate cookies]]. There's nothing like two types of chocolate in the same cookie to satisfy your cravings.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 40.jpg|center]]
#[[Make Thumbprint Cookies | Make thumbprint cookies]]. They're a combination of buttery shortbread and sweet jam.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 41.jpg|center]]
#[[Make Lemon Drop Cookies | Make lemon drop cookies]]. These little bursts of sunshine are a perfect treat for afternoon tea.[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 42.jpg|center]]
== Tips ==
* Set a timer or watch the time so your cookies don't burn.
* For the peanut butter cookies, keep them in a cool place for them to harden quicker. E.g. A windowsill or fridge.
* Just have fun making them.
== Warnings ==
*Do not eat raw cookie dough that contains raw egg.

==Ingredients==
===Chocolate Chip Cookies===
*1/2 cup unsalted butter, room temperature
*3/4 cup brown sugar
*3/4 cup white sugar
*2 eggs
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*12 ounces chocolate chips
*2 1/4 cups flour
*1/2 teaspoon baking soda
*1/2 teaspoon salt
===Sugar Cookies===
*1 cup butter, room temperature
*1 cup sugar
*1 egg
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*2 3/4 cups flour
*2 teaspoons baking powder
===No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies===
*1 3/4 cups sugar
*1/2 cup milk
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*1/2 cup peanut butter
*3 cups quick oatmeal
*1/2 teaspoon salt
===Ginger Cookies===
*3/4 cup butter, room temperature
*1/2 cup brown sugar
*1/2 cup white sugar
*1/4 cup molasses
*1 egg
*1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*2 cups flour
*1/2 teaspoon baking soda
*1/2 teaspoon salt
*1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
*1 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger
*1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
===Chocolate Chip Cookies===

#Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.

[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 4.jpg|center|550px]]
#Mix the dry ingredients. Put the flour, salt, and baking soda in a bowl and whisk them together.

#Cream the butter and sugars in a separate bowl. Place them in a large bowl and use a hand mixer to beat them together until the butter and sugars are fully combined and the mixture has turned light and fluffy.
#Add the eggs and vanilla. Keep beating the mixture until the eggs and vanilla are completely blended in.
#Stir in the flour mixture. Use a long-handled spoon to stir the dry ingredients in with the wet; keep stirring until you can't see any white specks of flour.
#Mix in the chocolate chips. Pour them into the bowl and use the spoon to mix them in with the batter.

#Drop spoonfuls of batter onto a baking sheet. Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to scoop even amounts of batter onto a baking sheet. Space them an inch or two apart so they'll have room to spread while baking.http://www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/food-network-kitchens/chocolate-chip-cookies-recipe4/index.html

[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 6.jpg|center|550px]]
#*To keep the cookies from sticking to the baking sheet, you can line it with parchment paper before placing the cookies on it.
#*For perfectly even cookies, use a 1/8 measuring cup to scoop the batter.

#Bake the cookies. Place the cookie sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes, or until they turn golden brown on top and the edges look slightly crisp.

[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 7.jpg|center|550px]]

#Remove the cookies from the oven to cool. Place them on a cooling rack or move them to a plate and let them cool until they aren't too hot to eat.

[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 10.jpg|center|550px]]

#Finished.

[[Image:Make Homemade Cookies Step 11.jpg|center|550px]]
===Sugar Cookies===
#Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
#Mix the dry ingredients. Place the flour, salt and baking soda in a bowl. Whisk until they are fully combined.
#Cream the wet ingredients in a separate bowl. Place the butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla in a bowl and beat until the ingredients are incorporated and the mixture is light and fluffy.
#Mix the wet and dry ingredients. Pour the flour mixture into the bowl of wet ingredients. Use a long-handled spoon to stir the batter until you can no longer see the specks of white flour.

#Drop the cookies onto a baking sheet. Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to place even amounts of cookie dough onto the baking sheet. Space them an inch or two apart to allow the cookies room to spread.<ref>http://www.food.com/recipe/eloises-easy-sugar-cookies-82945</ref>
#Flatten the cookies. Use the bottom of a drinking glass to press the cookies flat.
#Sprinkle the cookies with sugar. This will give the cookies a sweet, crunchy finish.
#Bake the cookies. Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes, or until the tops turn slightly golden.
#Let the cookies cool. Remove them from the oven and place them on a cooling rack or a plate. Let them cool for a minute or two before eating.
#Decorate the cookies. Sugar cookies are fun to decorate with glaze or icing. Add sprinkles or edible glitter to make them look festive.
===No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies===

#Boil the milk and sugar. Place them in a saucepan. Put the saucepan on the stove and turn the burner to medium high. Let the milk and sugar come to a boil and cook, stirring constantly, until the sugar dissolves, which should take about 5 minutes. Remove the mixture from heat.<ref>http://www.shugarysweets.com/2013/04/peanut-butter-no-bake-cookies</ref>
#Add the vanilla, peanut butter and salt. Pour the ingredients into the saucepan and stir them in until they're completely incorporated.
#*You can add 1/2 cup of cocoa powder to make chocolate peanut butter cookies.
#*Stir in 1/2
#Stir in the oatmeal.
#Scoop the cookies onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Use a spoon or a small ice cream scoop to scoop the batter in even amounts onto a baking sheet.
#Let the cookies cool for 15 minutes. As they cool, they'll harden slightly. When you can pick them up without them falling apart, they're ready to eat.
#Store leftover cookies in the refrigerator. Save some treats for later by storing them in the fridge, which will keep them from melting and falling apart.
===Ginger Cookies===
#Mix the dry ingredients. Put the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ground ginger, and ground cloves in a bowl. Use a whisk to stir the ingredients together.
#Cream the butter and sugars in a separate bowl. Place them in a mixing bowl and use a hand mixer to beat the ingredients until they become light and fluffy.

#Add the remaining wet ingredients. Place the egg, vanilla, and molasses in the bowl with the butter and sugars. Beat the wet ingredients until they are fully combined.<ref>http://www.joyofbaking.com/Gingersnaps.html</ref>
#Mix the wet and dry ingredients. Pour the flour mixture into the bowl with the wet ingredients. Use a spoon to stir the batter until you no longer see specks of white flour.

#Form the batter into a ball and chill it. Use your hands to form it into a ball shape, then place it on a sheet of plastic wrap and pull up the edges to completely wrap the dough ball. Put it in the refrigerator and chill for 1/2 hour.
#Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
#Roll out the dough. Remove the dough from the refrigerator, unwrap it, and put it on a floured work surface. Use a floured rolling pin to roll the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
#Cut the dough. Use a cookie cutter to cut the dough, then place the unbaked cookies on a baking sheet as you go.
#Bake the cookies. Place the cookie sheet in the oven and bake the cookies for 15 minutes. Remove them from the oven before the edges brown.
#Let the cookies cool. Place them on a cooling rack or a plate and let them cool for a minute before eating.
===Other Cookies===
#[[Make Almond Biscotti Cookies | Make homemade biscotti]]. This Italian cookie is usually served with espresso or red wine.
#[[Make Snickerdoodles | Make snickerdoodles]]. This riff on the sugar cookie combines the delectable flavors of cinnamon and sugar.
#[[Bake Oatmeal Cookies | Make oatmeal cookies]]. These hearty cookies make a great after school snack.
#[[Make Double Chocolate and Chocolate Chip Cookies | Make double chocolate cookies]]. There's nothing like two types of chocolate in the same cookie to satisfy your cravings.
#[[Make Thumbprint Cookies | Make thumbprint cookies]]. They're a combination of buttery shortbread and sweet jam.
#[[Make Lemon Drop Cookies | Make lemon drop cookies]]. These little bursts of sunshine are a perfect treat for afternoon tea.
* Set a timer or watch the time so your cookies don't burn.
*Do not eat raw cookie dough that contains raw egg.

== Steps ==
#  Buy a recipe book, espcially one for cookies.
#  Write down all ingredients and buy them or find them in your house.
#  Make sure you have all supplies.
#  Heat up oven first.
#  Follow all the steps in the book.
#  When mixed, use an ice cream scoop to make cookies even and prevent a mess on your hands.
#  Put cookies in oven.
#  Take wax paper, and if you have a cooling rack put that on top of wax paper.
#  Put cookies on cooling rack or wax paper when the oven goes off.
#  Let cookies cool until they are warm enough to eat.
#  Enjoy your homemade cookies!
== Tips ==
*Watch your cookies
== Warnings ==
*Wear oven mitts when reaching into oven
